svg.title: list: subscribe first, then ask once
svg.desc: The client subscribes to the meta of the children and to their liveliness, then sends one get for the list. The link answers Refreshed with the children. Later the link publishes a changed meta and the client gets Changed; when the link stops, its liveliness token goes and the client gets Disconnected.
